name: BEANZ AVI Player
author: BEANZ
description_short: Lightweight GameCube AVI player with MJPEG video, PCM audio, and AVIX continuation support
description_long: Play MJPEG AVI videos with 32 kHz stereo PCM audio on Nintendo GameCube. Supports AVIX continuation, SD2SP2, SD Gecko, and a built-in wallpaper. IMPORTANT: Before playing videos, read the GitHub README for required encoding settings, controls, known issues, and limitations
